description: Full monthly housing cost for a US mortgage: principal and interest, property tax, homeowners insurance, mortgage insurance and HOA dues, plus lifetime totals and payoff timing. Pass a state name to use that state's average property tax rate. This is the right tool for 'what would my payment be on a $400,000 house'.

inputSchema.description: Full monthly housing cost: principal, interest, taxes, insurance, PMI and HOA.

annualInsurance.description: Annual homeowners insurance premium in US dollars.

annualInterestRatePercent.description: Annual nominal interest rate as a percentage, for example 6.5 for 6.5%.

downPaymentPercent.description: Down payment as a percentage of the purchase price, 0 to 100. Not a dollar amount.

homePrice.description: Purchase price of the home in US dollars.

loanTermYears.description: Loan term in years. Most US mortgages are 15 or 30.

loanType.description: Loan programme. Affects mortgage insurance and upfront fees.

monthlyExtraPrincipal.description: Additional principal paid each month. Shortens the loan rather than lowering the payment.

monthlyHoa.description: Monthly homeowners association dues in US dollars.

propertyTaxRatePercent.description: Annual property tax as a percentage of home value. Omit and pass `state` instead to use that state's average.

state.description: Full US state name, for example "Texas". Used to look up the average property tax rate. Either this or propertyTaxRatePercent is required.

name: calculate_mortgage

outputSchema.description: Monthly housing cost, lifetime totals and payoff timing for one mortgage scenario.

amortizationYearCount.description: Years in the amortization schedule; use calculate_amortization for rows.

assumptions.description: The tax rate, its source and the mortgage insurance treatment used.

disclaimer.description: Estimate-only notice that should accompany any figure shown to a person.

extraMonthlyPayment.description: Extra principal paid each month, in dollars.

interestSaved.description: Interest avoided through extra principal, in dollars.

loanAmount.description: Amount borrowed after the down payment, in dollars.

monthlyMortgage.description: Monthly principal and interest, in dollars.

monthlyPmi.description: Monthly mortgage insurance, in dollars; 0 when none applies.

mortgageInsuranceLabel.description: Plain-language description of the mortgage insurance applied.

paymentsMade.description: Number of payments until the loan is repaid, counting extra principal.

propertyTaxRate.description: Annual effective property tax rate used, as a percentage.

scheduledPayments.description: Number of payments on the original schedule.

scheduledTotalInterest.description: Interest over the original schedule, with no extra principal.

state.description: State used to look up the tax rate. Absent when a rate was supplied directly.

totalAllPayments.description: Everything paid over the life of the loan, in dollars.

totalInterestPaid.description: Interest paid over the life of the loan, after extra principal.

totalMonthlyCost.description: All monthly costs combined, in dollars.

title: Calculate a monthly mortgage payment
